title: Önce bırakan

characters.MOM: a mother in her late fifties with curly greying hair, wearing a deep blue knitted shawl over a cream blouse
characters.WOMAN: a young woman of about twenty-six with a long dark ponytail, wearing a camel colored coat

scenes.text:
Annenle sarılınca
hep önce kim bırakıyor? Sen.
scenes.prompt: At the front door of a small house on an autumn afternoon, {WOMAN} gently steps back from a hug while {MOM} still holds her arms open, smiling, golden leaves on the steps.

scenes.text:
O kollarını biraz daha tutar,
sen "Tamam anne" deyip çekilirsin.
scenes.prompt: In the hallway by the door, {WOMAN} picks up her bag and looks at her watch, while {MOM} stands behind her watching her with a soft, longing smile, warm light.

scenes.text:
Otobüse binerken o hâlâ
kapıda, ellerini önlüğüne siliyor.
scenes.prompt: On a rainy autumn evening, a bus pulls away from a small stop while {MOM} stands at a distant garden gate waving, glowing street lamp, wet leaves.

scenes.text:
Bir gün o sarılmanın
bir dakikasına her şeyini verirsin.
scenes.prompt: At night by a rainy bus window, {WOMAN} sits alone looking out at passing city lights, a thoughtful, tender expression, warm reflections on the glass.

scenes.text:
Bu sefer bırakma; o bıraksın.
Bunu annene gönder, sıkı sarılın.
scenes.prompt: In a garden under a large tree with falling autumn leaves at sunset, {WOMAN} and {MOM} stand in a long, warm hug seen from a little distance, golden light.

caption:
Önce sen mi bırakıyorsun?

Annenin kolları hep biraz daha ister. 🤍

Bunu annene gönder, sıkı sarılın.
